	}
	for i = 1, #C do
		if i % 2 == 0 then C[i] = string.reverse(C[i]) end
	end
	local b64 = table.concat(C)

	local function b64decode(data)
		local dec = (crypt and (crypt.base64decode or (crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.decode)))
			or (syn and syn.crypt and syn.crypt.base64 and syn.crypt.base64.decode)
			or base64_decode
			or (base64 and base64.decode)
		if dec then
			local ok, res = pcall(dec, data)
			if ok and type(res) == 'string' and #res > 0 then return res end
		end
		local alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
		local inv = table.create(256)
		for i = 1, #alphabet do inv[string.byte(alphabet, i)] = i - 1 end
		local outt = table.create(math.floor(#data * 0.75) + 2)
		local n, i, len = 0, 1, #data
		while i <= len do
			local a = inv[string.byte(data, i)] or 0; i += 1
			local b = inv[string.byte(data, i)] or 0; i += 1
			local c = inv[string.byte(data, i)] or 0; i += 1
			local d = inv[string.byte(data, i)] or 0; i += 1
			n += 1; outt[n] = string.char((a * 4 + b // 16) % 256)
			if data:sub(i - 2, i - 2) ~= '=' then
				n += 1; outt[n] = string.char((b * 16 + c // 4) % 256)
			end
			if data:sub(i - 1, i - 1) ~= '=' then
				n += 1; outt[n] = string.char((c * 64 + d) % 256)
			end
		end
		return table.concat(outt)
	end

	local raw = b64decode(b64)
	assert(type(raw) == 'string' and #raw > 1000, 'decode failed')
	local key = {10,103,76,177,28,209,33,191,246,59,16,27,47,121,193,35}
	local klen = #key
	local buf = table.create(#raw)
	for i = 1, #raw do
		buf[i] = string.char(bit32.bxor(string.byte(raw, i), key[((i - 1) % klen) + 1]))
	end
	local src = table.concat(buf)
	local fn, err = (loadstring or load)(src)
	if not fn then error('compile: ' .. tostring(err)) end
	return fn()
end

task.spawn(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(bootstrap)
	if not ok then warn('[Cobalt Rspy]', err) end
end)
